name: Touno Arata
source:
A 19-year-old street musician who was introduced in the event story "Stray Bad Dog". He serves as a rival of sorts to [url=/c128186]Akito[/url]. His [url=/c128240]partner[/url] suffered from a career-ending injury leading to him going solo.
